name: Mercury three-axis hand controller
view: the hand controller from behind and left, as the astronaut in the couch sees it at the right armrest; forward is left: the pistol-type grip on its linkage housing; moved fore / aft for pitch, left / right for roll and twisted for yaw
origin: JoyPro's own vector drawing: the grip and housing reconstructed from the public Mercury spacecraft descriptions (NASA Project Mercury familiarization manual overview, Smithsonian museum descriptions, Wikipedia) and public museum photos looked at for proportions; not traced from a photo.
